integrity: The proof is an analytical Mellin-transform and rank-one resolvent argument supported by a reproducible finite numerical checker; numerical evidence is not substituted for proof or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The two sharp edge laws are derived for the single normalized exponential rank-one direction and real coupling. Qualitative existence and counting results were already known; an equivalent earlier quantitative treatment is possible. Numerical checks do not prove analytic claims.
title: Opposite weak-coupling scales for a rank-one exponential perturbation of the Carleman operator
